inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Permit holder responsibilities- Licensed Homes: Based on the preponderance of evidence obtained by DFPS it is determined that the permit holder is not meeting their responsibilities based on operational policies and is caring for children after operating hours past 10pm.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Permit holder responsibilities- Licensed Homes (26 TAC §747.117(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device: Based on DFPS findings it is determined that an infant was left asleep while in a highchair and was not removed from restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §747.2326(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: Based on DFPS finding it is determined that the operation was propping bottles with a blanket on child's bouncer and crib for feeding time since child was not able to hold bottle on their own.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §747.2319(2))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used: Based on DFPS findings it is determined that the operation was using stacked nap cots as a diaper changing area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - No Play or Eating Surfaces Used (26 TAC §747.3303(b))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate: Based on the preponderance of evidence obtained by DFPS it is determined that the operation was allowing children to sleep in highchairs and not placing them in age-appropriate sleeping equipment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §747.2405(1))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: Based on DFPS findings, it is determined that the operation primary caregiver and assistant caregiver did not have current pediatric first- aid and CPR
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver in Registered Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1007(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: 2 of the 5 records reviewed where not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Food Service and Preparation - No Foods That Present Choking Risk: Whole grapes were served for snak time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Service and Preparation - No Foods That Present Choking Risk (26 TAC §747.3117(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Carry Current Driver's License: Based on the preponderance obtained it is determined that the operation caregiver does not have a current driver's license.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Carry Current Driver's License (26 TAC §747.5417(b))

occurrences.finding: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction: 2 out of 3 staff files reviewed were missing medication training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Caregivers Required Annual Training-Required Topics without hour restriction (26 TAC §747.1305(d))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver in Licensed Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR: 1 out of 3 staff files reviewed had expired first aid and CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver in Licensed Home Qualifications - pediatric first-aid and pediatric CPR (26 TAC §747.1107(5))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Annual Certification: CPSC was last reviewed in Februrary of 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Annual Certification (26 TAC §747.3935(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Inspect Daily: Outdoor area was observed with part of the fence missing leading to another area of the yard with an unlit fire pit. Play equipment was also observed with bird droppings. A rake was observed along the fence.     *Rake was removed from outdoor area.   *Director stated fence would be repaired next week.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play Space - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §747.4407(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered: Outlets in the front room, infant room were observed un-covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §747.3501(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: Feeding instructions for a child not yet eating table food were not available for review at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §747.2321(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: Infant bottles were not labeled.     Note: This was corrected at inspection when provider labeled the bottles with the children's names.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §747.2319(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Feeding instructions for a child not yet eating table food were last reviewed / signed by parent on 06/05/2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §747.2321(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two out of four children's records reviewed are missing immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §747.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child: Two out two children's records reviewed are missing school information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - School Information for School-age Child (26 TAC §747.605(14))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: List of children, Emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported were not taken during transportation route.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms: Operation conducted a field trip during the month of April 2023.  Emergency medical consent forms and first aid kit were not taken during the field trip.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Field Trips - Emergency Medical Forms (26 TAC §747.2901(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: Based on the information obtained during the course of the investigation, children under the age of 5yo were placed in time-out for 5-10 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §747.2703(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year: Operation has not practice severe weather nor lock down drills.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Lock-down drill 4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §747.5005(3))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: Emergency Prepardness plan was reviewed and the folloing items are missing:    (1)(B) How children will be evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area or alternate shelter, including specific procedures for evacuating or relocating children who are under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility, or who otherwise may need assistance in an emergency, such as children who have mental, visual, or hearing impairments    1(D) The caregivers' responsibility in a sheltering/lock-down emergency for the orderly movement of children to a designated location in your home where children should gathe    1(E) Name and address of the alternate shelter away from the home you will use as needed    (4) How you will continue to care for the children until each child has been released     (5)How you will reunify the children with their parents as the evacuation, relocation, or sheltering/lock-down is lifted
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))
